lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text:
Vulture here. I heard gunfire.
Report.

lines.speaker: sterna
lines.text:
Putain.
Contact. One crew member, out of a berth on B Deck.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text:
Contact, boss. One crew member.
Came out of a berth on B Deck.

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text:
Contact, sir. One crew member.
Came out of a berth on B Deck.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text:
He saw us and came straight at us. No weapon, no warning.
He wasn't trying to fight, boss. He was trying to bite.

lines.speaker: sterna
lines.text:
He saw us and came straight at us. No weapon, niente.
He wasn't fighting, Vulture. He was trying to bite.

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text:
He came straight at us, sir. No weapon.
He wasn't fighting. He was biting.

lines.speaker: sterna
lines.text:
Allora.
What Bambi told us was true. That wasn't rage, Vulture. That was hunger.

alt.text:
Allora.
The kid was right. That wasn't rage, Vulture. That was hunger.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text:
What the kid told us was true.
That wasn't rage, boss. That was hunger.

alt.text:
The kid was right.
That wasn't rage, boss. That was hunger.

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text:
It's the same thing I saw, sir.
They're starving.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text:
Boss. If the rest of the crew is like that one...
how many are we talking about?

lines.speaker: sterna
lines.text:
Vulture. If the rest of the crew is like that one...
quanti? How many are we talking about?

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text:
Sir. If the rest of the crew is like that one...
how many?

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: A hull that size runs twenty to thirty hands.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: Assume all of them.

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text:
Sir.
That's twenty to thirty people still aboard.

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text: Are we still treating them as survivors?

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: I'm treating them as hostile.

lines.speaker: sterna
lines.text:
Genau.
Whatever that was, it stopped being crew a long time ago.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: Casualties?

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text: None.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text: The kid didn't make it, boss.

alt.text:
The kid didn't make it, boss.
Sterna's gone too.

lines.speaker: sterna
lines.text:
The kid didn't make it.
Bear's gone too. Los dos.

lines.speaker: sterna
lines.text:
Merde.
He walked out of that first boarding alive, and he didn't last the night.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text: He told us he wouldn't be dead weight.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text: Sterna went down covering him.

lines.speaker: sterna
lines.text:
Bear went down first.
He was trying to reach the kid. Il a essayé.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: That's a loss.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: Stay focused. We still have a ship to clear.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: Sterna.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: Bear.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text: We lost Sterna.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: One man. Unarmed.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: I trained her for eleven years and she goes down to one unarmed man.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: You were both busy keeping the kid breathing instead of watching your own backs.

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text: ...Understood, sir.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text: That's enough, boss.

lines.speaker: bear
lines.text:
From here on he stays with me.
If something gets to him, it goes through me first.

lines.speaker: sterna
lines.text: We lost Bear.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: One man. Unarmed.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: Bear has opened his way into forty ships and he goes down to one unarmed man.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: You were both busy keeping the kid breathing instead of watching your own backs.

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text: ...Understood, sir.

lines.speaker: sterna
lines.text:
Bambi.
Écoute-moi.

lines.speaker: sterna
lines.text:
Stay close to me and keep your head up.
Life gets very short out here. En un segundo, y ya está.

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text:
I'm alone, sir.
Sterna and Bear are both gone.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: Both of them.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text:
I came aboard with three of my people, Coast Guard.
Now I have you.

lines.speaker: deer
lines.text: ...Understood, sir.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: You're the only one left out there, Bear.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: You're the only one left out there, Sterna.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: Listen to me.

alt.text: Listen to me, all three of you.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: Long range is still jammed. I cannot reach Command.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: If one of you takes a serious hit out there, I have no way to get you off this ship.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: No evac. No medevac. Nothing.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text: So don't take one.

lines.speaker: vulture
lines.text:
Keep the channel open.
Vulture out.
